procedure.title: Replace Permission Denial Blocks
procedure.description: Convert ad-hoc permission denial handling into the standardized default_permission_denial helper pattern.

step.action: Locate all except blocks catching PermissionError (or equivalent).
Ensure inspect is imported at the top of the file.

step.before: except PermissionError as e: return HttpResponseForbidden(str(e))

step.action: Add a catch-all Exception handler immediately after, if not present.
Verify the method has an explicitly typed return annotation.

procedure.title: Setup Class Conventions
procedure.description: Apply standard class structure: acronym constant, @classmethod pattern, and proper name references.

step.action: Add the class-name acronym constant in the class body.
Convert factory or auth-dependent methods to @classmethod.
step.template: @classmethod def create(cls, data: dict) -> "MyService": cn = cls.__name__ fn = inspect.currentframe().f_code.co_name logger.info(f"{cn}::{fn} invoked") instance = cls() # ... build from data ... return instance

step.action: Audit existing @staticmethod decorators. If the method references cls, self, auth utilities, or error handlers, convert to @classmethod.
Replace all hardcoded class-name strings with the _CN constant (instance methods) or cls.__name__ (classmethods).
Abstract repetitive permission checks into a private method.

procedure.title: Type Hinting Audit
procedure.description: Systematically audit and fix missing type hints across all Python files in the project.

step.action: Run a search for functions/methods missing return annotations.
Run a search for parameters missing type annotations (excluding self/cls).
For each match, determine the correct types from usage context, docstrings, or tests.
Add type hints. Use Union or Optional where needed. Use concrete types over Any.
step.after: def process(data: dict[str, Any], flag: bool) -> ProcessResult: ...

step.action: Run mypy or pyright to validate all annotations are correct.
Confirm no function uses semicolons as statement separators. Replace with newlines if found.
